test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a constitutional body?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the National Commission for Minorities**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Commission for Minorities (NCM**) is not a constitutional body, but rather a statutory body.
 
• The NCM was **established by the National Commission for Minoritie**s Act of 1992. 
 
• **The NCM's functions include: **
 
 
• Monitoring the safeguards for minorities in the Constitution and in laws
 
• Ensuring that the **Prime Minister's 15-Point Programme **for the Welfare of Minorities is implemented
 
• Evaluating the development of minorities in the Union and States
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comptroller and Auditor General of India **

 
 
• The CAG is **responsible for auditing the accounts o**f the government of India.
 
• The current CAG is K**. Sanjay Murthy**.
 
 
 
• **Special Officer for Linguistic Minoritie**s
 
 
• Also known as the **Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities (CLM**), this officer investigates issues related to linguistic minorities in India. 
 
• The CLM is **appointed by the President of India. **
 
• The CLM reports to the President, who then shares the reports with Parliament and the state governments. 
 
 
 
• **Attorney General of India **
 
 
• **​**The Attorney General of India (AGI) **is the country's chief law officer. **
 
• The AGI **advises the Union government **on legal issues referred by the President. 
 
• The AGI is the government's main lawyer in the Supreme Court of India.​
